Name: Zoning, 21-31 46th Ave Rezoning, Queens (C 250125 ZMQ).
Title: Application number C 250125 ZMQ (21-31 46th Ave Rezoning) submitted by 21-31 Holdings LLC, pursuant to Sections 197-c and 201 of the New York City Charter for an amendment of the Zoning Map, Section No. 9b, changing from an M1-4/R6B District to an R7X District and establishing within the proposed R7X District a C2-5 District, Borough of Queens, Community District 2, Council District 26.

History.Description: This Land Use Application was Introduced by Council
